Utril, home of the Spore Lizards, infested with arachnids. This moon is home to a research lab where they dabbled into the cloning of wildlife. To better harvest the goodies from the Spore Lizards. Every science has its risks however.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Executed.

CONDITIONS: Dark, dry terrain, poisonous atmosphere populated by Lycoperdon perlatum.

FAUNA: A flawed ecosystem, home to Lacerta-glomerorum, dominated by arachnids.

> Environment

Unfinished Section

This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section.

Utril's flora consists of larger Pyntrus Lotuses and Puffbulbs. Similar to Spore Lizards and the scrap, approaching the Puffbulbs will release a temporary purple cloud that obscures player vision.

> Weather

Utril can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Breakable Trees

On the path to the main entrance, a map can be found that reads "Do not touch or hit these trees". Two trees can be located on this same path marked by an X on the map, one being directly behind the map, and can be hit with a shovel or knife. Hitting both trees will collapse the platform above the main entrance, crushing any player underneath it. This allows for easier traversal to the fire exit on top of the platform without needing to climb a vine (ladder) or use other tools. The main entrance is still accessible through a small crack behind the fire exit building and it is possible to get back up. However, it is recommended to exit through a fire exit or use an extension ladder to get back up due to the difficulty at higher weights.

Acid Tanks

Utril's interior features a unique map hazard called an "Acid Tank". If any injured player walks underneath this tank, it will begin spraying acid for about 12 seconds in a small area. Additionally, a puddle of acid will form below the tank and linger for roughly 70 seconds after the tank has finished spraying. Both the acid spray and puddle deal 5 damage per hit to any player standing inside of them, but the puddle deals damage at a slower rate. The puddle will still be visible but not deal any damage to the player after this timeframe.

Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot)

Utril's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, run up the hill behind the ship, turn left, and run along the right wall. This mysterious object is a Brooding seed that can be found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of Berunah. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet."

This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, visually alters the interior, and causes the Assimilated Growth to almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on the moon in the future. All these changes also apply to Vindict.

This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of Etern, Filitrios, Fission-C, and Gloom, in which case these changes become permanent on that save file.

Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Utril's exterior. If players land on Utril in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Interacting with the map found on the exterior of Thalasso.
Alternatively, inserting the Utril videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Cosmocos, Desolation, Gloom, or Gratar into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Cubatres: Find the fire exit that's besides the test tubes. Follow that path that goes down and keep an eye on an opening on your right. In the opening you will find a map drawn on the ground. Interacting with this will cause a short cutscene then unlock Cubatres.
Filitrios: Filitrios videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Desolation: Log "Harrington's Crash Log" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
End: Acquire the destiny item "Harrington's research 4" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior and insert it into the destiny item slot before taking off in the abandoned ship on Repress.
Vindict: Vindict videotape that spawns randomly as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Harrington's Crash Log & Harrington's Research Logs

Harrington's Crash Log and Harrington's research can spawn randomly as scrap within the interior and continue the story of Professor Harrington, a scientist previously researching on Cosmocos before its split and teleportation. After leaving the split chunk of Cosmocos that came to be known as Desolation, Harrington crash landed on either an undisclosed location or Utril itself and aided in major breakthroughs in the cloning process after recovering. Once the military got involved, Professor Harrington sabotaged the project by removing any mention or research of a chemical that prevents clones from dying of cancer in about a month.

Harrington's Crash Log

Text ⁠
The past few weeks have been difficult.
My memory hasn't been the same since the crash.
I do not recall much from before.
All that remains is some faint visions of self healing flesh, independently growing eyes and a bright flash before panic ensued.
4 of us fled to one of ships and escaped the scene.
I don't know what happened to the other two teams who were present at the time.
I have now come to know that the entirety of Cosmocos vanished. And what we were standing on was merely a severed chunk of it.

Nobody has dared to return. We called it Desolation.
I'll attach the coordinates to this log for anyone brave enough to have a look for themselves.
After my recovery I might be able to help the people out over here.
I've heard some interesting projects being discussed.

Professor Harrington, over and out.

Harrington's Research Log 1

Text ⁠
It's been a while now since my arrival at this facility.
I've been closely paying attention to the projects here.
I was told that moon is THE home of the Lacerta-glomerorum.
Or.. spore lizards in the common tongue.
This is where they are most frequently hunted.
However, in the labs they seem to be working on cloning technology.
The cloning of creatures to be more specific.
I feel it's right up my alley.
Professor Harrington, over and out.

Harrington's Research Log 2

Text ⁠
I wanted to give an update to my time here.
The cloning process is very complex but the technology is easy to produce.
When they explained to me the current state of the project I was told that they had figured out how to grow a spore lizard from practically nothing to a fully functioning adult in the matter of days.
However there was one fatal flaw.
Due to GYN-H chemicals used in the process of speeding up the development of the creature, a unique form of cancer would grow in the brain which, after about a month would kill it.
But I think I came up with a solution, LYN-H is a very similar chemical to GYN-H, It's only down one component.
I've theorised this could be the required change.
Professor Harrington, over and out.

Harrington's Research Log 3

Text ⁠
Not weeks ago we had a big breakthrough with one of my theories.
Now yesterday our front door was broken though.
After having celebrated our victory in the cloning of spore lizards we weren't expecting to see the military show up to investigate our lab.
But after learning about our success in the cloning department, we had a.. less than peaceful discussion as they had brought it to their higher ranks who now demand to use it to clone.. people.. for the war of course.
This leaves us with a choice, we either give them an unlimited army.. or we destroy all our progress.

I have to take my leave.
Professor Harrington, over and out.

Harrington's Research Log 4

Text ⁠
This will be my last day here, after today, I will be fleeing once more.
But to someplace safe this time.
We had come to the decision that the decades of research was simply too valuable to destroy.
So we have handed them the tools, the research and they will likely proceed with making their own soldier in labs.
The prospect of that is horrifying.
Or.. well
It would have been had I not removed any mention of LYN-H, the one thing that prevents clones from dying shortly after being created.
The armies they grow will all drop dead within a month after being created.
Time to find a brighter horizon.
Professor Harrington, over.. and out.

Map of Cubatres

Somewhere on moon's exterior there's a hidden map on the ground that you can interact with. When you proceed to do so a strange audio will play. After that Cubatres will be unlocked for you.

Image & Text ⁠
Out in the unknown, the light shines in mysterious ways, beauty you willl find before death takes you away.

Utril Videotape

If the player randomly finds Utril's videotape in the interior of other moons and inserts it into the projector in Galetry, Professor Harrington will also describe the environment of Utril.
This videotape can be found on Gloom, Gratar, Desolation and Cosmocos.

Text ⁠
I really am cursed to live out my days recording with subpar recording devices.

This is professor Harrington and I have found myself to be on Utril.
The days may be darker than the nights yet it has a strange sense of beauty.
It is not a place I ever expected to visit.
The wildlife is unlike the usual, not very diverse.
Generally consistent of spore lizards and arachnids.
It was surprising to learn that it wasn't the spiders that were the aggressive ones here.
They were much more keen on posing for a picture.
Either way,
I'm needed back in the labs.
Professor Harrington, over and out.
